name: INVOICE
description: The root business group representing the entire electronic invoice document. Contains all other BGs and document-level BTs

name: Invoice number
description: A unique identifier assigned by the Seller to identify the invoice within the Seller's system. No identification scheme should be used

name: Invoice issue date
description: The date on which the invoice was issued. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

name: Invoice type code
description: A code specifying the functional type of the invoice. Code list: UNTDID 1001. Permitted values: 326 (partial), 380 (commercial), 381 (credit note), 384 (corrected), 389 (self-billed), 875/876/877 (construction invoices)

name: Invoice currency code
description: The currency in which all invoice amounts are expressed (except BT-111). Code list: ISO 4217 (alpha-3 only)

name: VAT accounting currency code
description: The currency used for VAT accounting and reporting, applicable in the Seller's country. Code list: ISO 4217

name: Value added tax point date
description: The date on which VAT becomes accountable for the Seller and Buyer

name: Value added tax point date code
description: A code determining the VAT point date when BT-7 is not yet known at invoicing time. Code list: UNTDID 2005 (codes: 3, 35, 432)

name: Payment due date
description: The date by which payment is due. Represents the net payment date; for partial payments, this is the first instalment date

name: Buyer reference
description: An identifier assigned by the Buyer for internal routing purposes (e.g., cost centre, department code)

name: Project reference
description: An identifier of a project the invoice relates to

name: Contract reference
description: A unique identifier of a contract (e.g., contract number)

name: Purchase order reference
description: An identifier of a referenced purchase order issued by the Buyer

name: Sales order reference
description: An identifier of a referenced sales order issued by the Seller

name: Receiving advice reference
description: An identifier for a referenced receiving advice

name: Despatch advice reference
description: An identifier for a referenced despatch advice (delivery note)

name: Tender or lot reference
description: The identifier of a tender or lot the invoice relates to

name: Invoiced object identifier
description: A Seller-assigned identifier for the object referenced by the invoice (e.g., meter number, subscription number, vehicle registration)

name: Buyer accounting reference
description: A text value specifying where the relevant data is to be entered in the Buyer's financial accounts

name: Payment terms
description: A textual description of payment terms (including early payment discounts/Skonto)

name: INVOICE NOTE
description: A group of business terms providing textual notes relevant to the invoice, with optional subject code

name: Invoice note subject code
description: The subject of the following textual note. Code list: UNTDID 4451

name: Invoice note
description: A free-text note providing unstructured information relevant to the invoice as a whole. Can include archiving obligation notes per § 14 Abs. 4 Nr. 9 UStG

name: PROCESS CONTROL
description: A group identifying the business process context and the specification the invoice conforms to

name: Business process type
description: Identifies the business process context (enables Buyer to route the invoice)

name: Specification identifier
description: Identifies the specification (CIUS/profile) the invoice data conforms to. No scheme identifier used

name: PRECEDING INVOICE REFERENCE
description: A group of terms for referencing one or more preceding invoices (corrections, final invoices referencing advance payments)

name: Preceding Invoice reference
description: The identifier of the preceding invoice being referenced

name: Preceding Invoice issue date
description: The issue date of the preceding invoice

name: SELLER
description: A group of terms providing information about the Seller (supplier/vendor)

name: Seller name
description: The full formal name of the Seller as registered in the national register of legal entities or as a taxable person

name: Seller trading name
description: A name under which the Seller is known, if different from the Seller name

name: Seller identifier
description: A Seller identifier (e.g., creditor number, supplier number assigned by the Buyer)

name: Seller legal registration identifier
description: An identifier issued by an official registrar identifying the Seller as a legal entity

name: Seller VAT identifier
description: The Seller's VAT registration number, prefixed with country code per ISO 3166-1

name: Seller tax registration identifier
description: A local tax identification of the Seller, or reference to registered tax status

name: Seller additional legal information
description: Additional legal information about the Seller (e.g., share capital, legal form)

name: Seller electronic address
description: The Seller's electronic address for receiving application-level responses
datatype: Identifier (+BT-34-1 Scheme ID from EAS, mandatory)

name: SELLER POSTAL ADDRESS
description: The Seller's postal address

name: Seller address line 1
description: The main address line (typically street name and number)

name: Seller address line 2
description: An additional address line

name: Seller address line 3
description: A third address line (added in maintenance release)

name: Seller city
description: The city/town of the Seller's address

name: Seller post code
description: The postal/ZIP code

name: Seller country subdivision
description: The country subdivision (state, province, region)

name: Seller country code
description: Code list: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

name: SELLER CONTACT
description: Contact information for the Seller

name: Seller contact point
description: The name of the contact person or department

name: Seller contact telephone number
description: The telephone number

name: Seller contact email address
description: The email address

name: BUYER
description: A group providing information about the Buyer (customer)

name: Buyer name
description: The full name of the Buyer as legally registered

name: Buyer trading name
description: A name under which the Buyer is known, if different from the legal name

name: Buyer identifier
description: An identifier of the Buyer (e.g., customer account number)

name: Buyer legal registration identifier
description: An official registration identifier of the Buyer as a legal entity

name: Buyer VAT identifier
description: The Buyer's VAT registration number, prefixed per ISO 3166-1

name: Buyer electronic address
description: The Buyer's electronic address for receiving invoices
datatype: Identifier (+BT-49-1 Scheme ID from EAS, mandatory)

name: BUYER POSTAL ADDRESS
description: The Buyer's postal address

name: Buyer address line 3
description: (Added in maintenance release.)

name: Buyer country code
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

name: BUYER CONTACT
description: Contact information for the Buyer

name: PAYEE
description: A group providing information about the Payee (party receiving payment, if different from Seller)

name: Payee name
description: The name of the Payee

name: Payee identifier
description: An identifier for the Payee

name: SELLER TAX REPRESENTATIVE PARTY
description: The Seller's tax representative (fiscal representative)

name: Seller tax representative VAT identifier
description: The VAT identifier of the tax representative, prefixed per ISO 3166-1

name: SELLER TAX REPRESENTATIVE POSTAL ADDRESS
description: The postal address of the tax representative. Card: 1..1 (within BG-11)

name: Tax representative address line 3
description: (Added in maintenance release.)

name: Tax representative country code
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

name: DELIVERY INFORMATION
description: A group providing delivery details

name: Deliver to party name
description: The name of the party to whom goods are delivered or services are provided

name: Deliver to location identifier
description: An identifier for the delivery location (e.g., GLN)

name: Actual delivery date
description: The date on which delivery was made or services completed

name: INVOICING PERIOD
description: The period to which the invoice applies (document level)

name: DELIVER TO ADDRESS
description: The address to which goods are delivered or at which services are provided

name: Deliver to address line 3
description: (Added in maintenance release.)

name: Deliver to country code
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2

name: PAYMENT INSTRUCTIONS
description: A group providing information about how and to whom payment is made

name: Payment means type code
description: Code list: UNTDID 4461. Identifies the payment method (e.g., 30=credit transfer, 48=bank card, 49=direct debit, 58=SEPA credit transfer, 59=SEPA direct debit)

name: Payment means text
description: A descriptive text for the payment method. In UBL, carried in @name attribute of PaymentMeansCode

name: Remittance information
description: A textual value for payment reconciliation (reference number for the Seller)

name: CREDIT TRANSFER
description: A group providing bank account details for credit transfer payments

name: Payment account identifier
description: The account number (IBAN for SEPA)

name: Payment account name
description: The name of the account holder

name: Payment service provider identifier
description: The BIC code of the payment service provider (bank)

name: PAYMENT CARD INFORMATION
description: Card payment details

name: Payment card primary account number
description: The truncated PAN (last 4–6 digits only)

name: DIRECT DEBIT
description: Direct debit mandate details

name: Mandate reference identifier
description: The SEPA mandate reference

name: Bank assigned creditor identifier
description: The Seller's creditor ID assigned by the bank

name: Debited account identifier
description: The Buyer's account to be debited (IBAN for SEPA)

name: DOCUMENT LEVEL ALLOWANCES
description: Allowances (discounts/rebates) applicable to the entire invoice

name: Document level allowance amount
description: The net amount of the allowance

name: Document level allowance base amount
description: The base on which the allowance percentage is calculated

name: Document level allowance VAT category code
description: UNTDID 5305 (S, Z, E, AE, K, G, O, L, M)

name: Document level allowance VAT rate
description: The VAT rate for this allowance

name: Document level allowance reason
description: The reason for the allowance in text form

name: Document level allowance reason code
description: UNTDID 5189

name: DOCUMENT LEVEL CHARGES
description: Charges (surcharges/fees) applicable to the entire invoice

name: Document level charge VAT category code
description: UNTDID 5305

name: Document level charge reason code
description: UNTDID 7161

name: DOCUMENT TOTALS
description: The totals of the invoice

name: Sum of Invoice line net amount
description: The total of all invoice line net amounts

name: Sum of allowances on document level
description: Total of all document-level allowance amounts

name: Sum of charges on document level
description: Total of all document-level charge amounts

name: Invoice total amount without VAT
description: The total before VAT

name: Invoice total VAT amount
description: The total VAT amount in invoice currency (BT-5)

name: Invoice total VAT amount in accounting currency
description: The VAT total in the accounting currency (BT-6)

name: Invoice total amount with VAT
description: The total including VAT

name: Paid amount
description: Amount already paid (advance payments, prepayments)

name: Rounding amount
description: The difference between BT-112 and the actual rounded amount

name: Amount due for payment
description: The outstanding amount to be paid

name: VAT BREAKDOWN
description: A group providing the VAT breakdown per rate/category

name: VAT category taxable amount
description: The taxable base for this VAT category/rate

name: VAT category tax amount
description: The calculated VAT amount for this category

name: VAT category code
description: UNTDID 5305. Values: S (standard), Z (zero-rated), E (exempt), AE (reverse charge), K (intra-community), G (export), O (outside scope), L (Canary Islands IGIC), M (Ceuta/Melilla IPSI)

name: VAT category rate
description: The VAT rate for this category. Must be 0 for categories Z, E, AE, K, G, O

name: VAT exemption reason text
description: The reason for exemption from VAT, in text

name: VAT exemption reason code
description: Code list: VATEX (CEF VATEX code list)

name: ADDITIONAL SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS
description: Attached or referenced documents supporting the invoice

name: Supporting document reference
description: The identifier of the supporting document

name: Supporting document description
description: A description of the attached/referenced document

name: External document location
description: A URL where the document can be accessed

name: Attached document
description: An embedded binary attachment
datatype: Binary Object (+mime code from IANA media types, +filename)

name: INVOICE LINE
description: An individual line item of the invoice

name: Invoice line identifier
description: A unique identifier for the line within this invoice

name: Invoice line note
description: A textual note providing additional line-level information

name: Invoice line object identifier
description: An identifier for an object referenced at line level (e.g., subscription number, meter reading)

name: Invoiced quantity
description: The quantity of items invoiced on this line

name: Invoiced quantity unit of measure code
description: Code list: UN/ECE Rec 20 + Rec 21. The unit of measure for BT-129

name: Invoice line net amount
description: The net amount of the line (exclusive of VAT)

name: Referenced purchase order line reference
description: The line number within the purchase order referenced by BT-13

name: Invoice line Buyer accounting reference
description: A reference for the Buyer's accounting system at line level

name: INVOICE LINE PERIOD
description: The period to which this specific line item applies

name: INVOICE LINE ALLOWANCES
description: Allowances applicable to a specific invoice line

name: Invoice line allowance reason code
description: UNTDID 5189

name: INVOICE LINE CHARGES
description: Charges (surcharges) applicable to a specific invoice line

name: Invoice line charge reason code
description: UNTDID 7161

name: PRICE DETAILS
description: Price information for the invoiced item

name: Item net price
description: The price of the item after any price discount (BT-147) has been applied. Must not be negative

name: Item price discount
description: The discount applied to the gross price to arrive at the net price

name: Item gross price
description: The gross price before discount. Must not be negative

name: Item price base quantity
description: The number of item units to which the price applies (e.g., price per 100 units). Must be > 0

name: Item price base quantity unit of measure code
description: UN/ECE Rec 20+21. Must equal BT-130 when present

name: LINE VAT INFORMATION
description: VAT information for the invoiced item

name: Invoiced item VAT category code
description: UNTDID 5305. Same code list as BT-118

name: Invoiced item VAT rate
description: The VAT rate applicable to the item

name: ITEM INFORMATION
description: A group of terms providing identifying and descriptive information about the invoiced item

name: Item name
description: A name for the item (a short description)

name: Item description
description: A longer description of the item

name: Item Seller's identifier
description: The identifier assigned to the item by the Seller (catalogue/article number)

name: Item Buyer's identifier
description: The identifier assigned to the item by the Buyer

name: Item standard identifier
description: An item identifier based on a global standard (e.g., GTIN/EAN)
datatype: Identifier (+BT-157-1 Scheme ID from ICD, mandatory when BT-157 present)

name: Item classification identifier
description: An item classification code (e.g., CPV, UNSPSC, eCl@ss)
datatype: Identifier (+BT-158-1 listID from UNTDID 7143, mandatory; +BT-158-2 listVersionID, optional)

name: Item country of origin
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. The country where the item originates

name: ITEM ATTRIBUTES
description: Additional attributes (name/value pairs) for the item

name: Item attribute name
description: The name of the attribute

name: Item attribute value
description: The value of the attribute
